notes: CreatePlaylistsContainer: the binary returns the pointer NativePlaylistsManager::Init allocates (void* in the binary); the port returns IsValid() as int, so the pointer value is not reproduced

DecoderNativeCursor C1: body reproduced (playlist copy, PCM format 1 or IMA format 17 with two states each, track parameters, frame capacity 600*channels*word2/500). Partial because header_words_ is filled only by ParseFile, which is not complete
DecoderNativeCursor C2: same body as C1 (0x8742f4), partial for the same reason

VoxNativeSubDecoder C1: stream, header words, containers and playlists stored; the 3 segment records and the scalar defaults written as in the pseudocode. The mangled order is kept; the header block is passed as NativeHeaderWords
VoxNativeSubDecoder C2: same body as C1 (0x885d44)

NativeSubDecoderState C1: scalar defaults checked against SetStopped (chunk -1, play mode 0, state 2, one entry with one left, decoding slot -1). A null manager gets a default manager; the original always copies
NativeSubDecoderState C2: same body as C1 (0x8860dc)

VoxNativeSubDecoderIMAADPCM C1: base constructor, then three decode buffers (each 4 bytes per byte of block), the pending block and frames per block (2*(bytes-4*channels)/channels+1); 0 channels or more than 8 zero the track words; a failed allocation zeroes them too
VoxNativeSubDecoderIMAADPCM C2: same body as C1 (0x886bfc)
VoxNativeSubDecoderPCM C1: base constructor call; the PCM vtable is the compiler-generated one
VoxNativeSubDecoderPCM C2: same body as C1 (0x888514)
